questions: Delivery is not available today — would you like to change your request to pickup at 1:00 p.m. today for Fictional Studio D?
If pickup works, what pickup time and contact name should we hold for human review?
result.reply: Hello! Thanks for your request for two cheese pizzas for 1 p.m. today — I have not confirmed anything, just checking as you asked. For today, we are pickup only, so delivery to Fictional Studio D is not possible. The 1 p.m. time would meet our 90-minute lead time for pickup if you would like that. Could you let us know if you would like to switch to pickup? This draft is awaiting human review and nothing is booked yet.
